topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 68 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 14 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 34 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontrolledandupgradeable, staker, boringownabledata). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
